name: Ahe Tsuma Yayoi ~Netorare Kegasareru Bijin Tsuma~
original_name: アヘ妻・弥生 ～寝取られ汚される美人妻～
source:
Yayoi lives a happy life with her family. 
But for a long while she's been in a sexless marriage. 

One day her husband brings home some coworkers. 
They take an instant like to the smoldering, neglected womanhood of Yayoi. As her husband gets drunk, his coworkers creep up on her... But it doesn't end with that one disgraceful event. Now she's got to keep that indiscretion secret... by continuing to sleep with the men or else they'll ruin everything! 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088074.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
弥生与家人过着幸福的生活。
但她的无性婚姻已经持续了很长时间。

某天，丈夫带了几名同事回家。
他们一眼就看上了弥生那被忽视的、闷烧着的女人味。丈夫喝醉后，同事们悄悄靠近了她……但事情并没有在那一次不光彩的事件中结束。现在她必须保守那次越轨的秘密……继续和那些男人上床，否则他们就会毁掉一切！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088074.html]DLsite English[/url]]
